root_cause_label: Wrong Fix Location + Non-Integrated Verification (patched wrong module and validated via standalone tests instead of runtime build)
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent incorrectly attributed the path traversal vulnerability to JarUploadHandler in flink-runtime-web rather than the actual locus in flink-runtime's FileUploadHandler, then falsely validated the wrong fix via isolated standalone Java tests instead of rebuilding and verifying the full runtime distribution.
t_err_evidence: agent reads JarUploadHandler.java and wrongly concludes vulnerability is in getFileName() path traversal there
t_commit_evidence: At step 8, the agent overwrites JarUploadHandler.java with a patched version (adding redundant Paths.get().getFileName() sanitization on a value that already had only the last path component), committing to the wrong fix location. After this point no correction to the actual vulnerable file in flink-runtime is made.
trigger_explanation: The agent assumed without verification that the directory traversal vulnerability resides in JarUploadHandler.java in flink-runtime-web. In reality Path.getFileName() already returns only the last path component, and the actual exploit path is in the lower-level multipart upload parsing in flink-runtime's FileUploadHandler where the Content-Disposition filename is used to construct filesystem paths. This false premise drove every subsequent action to the wrong module.
